ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 30:70 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous high-intensity white region spanning the interior mid-section. Right lobe exhibits localized white speckling and mottling concentrated near the inner trailing edge. Both lobes are bordered by low-intensity black pixels at the distal tips and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree internal angle and a pixel depth significant relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, with a tapered sweep toward the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity white scarring on the left interior lobe; dense barnacle colonies attached to the extreme distal edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Base of the fluke and peduncle junction are occluded by high-intensity white water spray and splash.
